## Summary

- What user-facing result does this change produce?

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] Checked the relevant path in the UI (image, PDF, or text), including an authorized sample when possible

## Notes

- Detection and cleanup changes should include a test, especially false-positive cases.
- Do not add features meant to strip copyright marks, licenses, signatures, or authenticity systems from other people's material.
